--- select_multiple_named_args.sql
SELECT F(1, x => 2, y => 3)

--- AST
&ast.QueryStatement{
  Query: &ast.Select{
    Results: []ast.SelectItem{
      &ast.ExprSelectItem{
        Expr: &ast.CallExpr{
          Rparen: 26,
          Func:   &ast.Path{
            Idents: []*ast.Ident{
              &ast.Ident{
                NamePos: 7,
                NameEnd: 8,
                Name:    "F",
              },
            },
          },
          Args: []ast.Arg{
            &ast.ExprArg{
              Expr: &ast.IntLiteral{
                ValuePos: 9,
                ValueEnd: 10,
                Base:     10,
                Value:    "1",
              },
            },
          },
          NamedArgs: []*ast.NamedArg{
            &ast.NamedArg{
              Name: &ast.Ident{
                NamePos: 12,
                NameEnd: 13,
                Name:    "x",
              },
              Value: &ast.IntLiteral{
                ValuePos: 17,
                ValueEnd: 18,
                Base:     10,
                Value:    "2",
              },
            },
            &ast.NamedArg{
              Name: &ast.Ident{
                NamePos: 20,
                NameEnd: 21,
                Name:    "y",
              },
              Value: &ast.IntLiteral{
                ValuePos: 25,
                ValueEnd: 26,
                Base:     10,
                Value:    "3",
              },
            },
          },
        },
      },
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
SELECT F(1, x => 2, y => 3)
